summary: Cemex filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing its first quarter 2026 results. The filing reports record EBITDA of US$794 million, up 34% YoY, and highlights progress on Project Cutting Edge, a portfolio rebalancing strategy including a divestiture in Colombia and acquisition of Omega. Share repurchases of US$100 million and a 40% dividend increase are noted. This is a routine earnings release with no special-situation event such as an M&A transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing is a standard periodic update, not a special situation.
